description: D9: tenant-bound store role of the hybrid ledger's tenant partitions (libs/core/ledger.ts). libs/core/ledger.ts assumes it (withExecutionContext) for every tenant partition read and append, always bound to the record's tenant, so the grants resolve through ${KYBERION_TENANT} to that one tenant's active/shared/runtime/tenant-ledger/<tier>/<tenant>/ partition: it reads the hash-chain tail, appends tenant records and tenant mission metadata, and verifies the chain. Tenant-bound (TENANT_BOUND_READER_ROLES): a caller with another active tenant cannot bind it. No knowledge, mission, system-ledger or customer/ grant.
